content: Sigma-Aldrich Corporation, headquartered in St. Louis, Missouri, is a supplier of reagents and materials used in research and development, diagnostics, and analytical applications. The company operates facilities in 36 countries and manufactures many of the chemicals it sells. Sigma-Aldrich offers a diverse range of product lines, each marketed under distinct branding. These include life science products, biochemicals, chemistry-related products, analytical and chromatography tools, research essentials (such as solvents, buffers, acids/bases, and general reagents), equipment, books, and supplies, as well as large-scale chemicals and contract manufacturing services. Aldrich Aldrich specializes in the research and fine chemicals market, providing materials for drug discovery, material science, and chemical synthesis. It is widely recognized among research chemists for its extensive product selection. Aldrich's Sure-Seal bottles, featuring a PTFE-lined septum within a crown cap, allow for the dispensing of contents under an inert gas atmosphere. Additionally, the Atmos Bag is a sealable glove bag designed for handling airand moisture-sensitive materials in an inert atmosphere, such as nitrogen. The Aldrich chemical catalog, known as the Aldrich Catalog and Handbook, is frequently used as a reference due to its inclusion of chemical structures, physical data, and literature references. It is particularly popular among undergraduate students, as it is available for free upon request. Sigma Sigma serves as the primary biochemical supplier for Sigma-Aldrich, offering a wide array of products including antibiotics, buffers, carbohydrates, enzymes, forensic tools, hematology and histology reagents, nucleotides, proteins, peptides, amino acids, and their derivatives. Sigma RBI Sigma RBI focuses on specialized products for cell signaling and neuroscience research. Their offerings range from standard biochemical reagents to advanced research tools, including novel ligands for receptors and ion channels, innovative enzyme inhibitors, phospho-specific antibodies, key signal transduction enzymes, and assay kits for cell signaling studies. ISOTEC ISOTEC provides isotopically labeled products for applications such as protein structure determination, peptide synthesis, proteomics, metabolic research, magnetic resonance imaging (MRI), nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR), breath test substrates, agriculture, and gas or gas mixture studies. Fluka Riedel-de Haën Fluka Riedel-de Haën operates in the fields of analytical chemistry, biochemistry, and organic chemistry, offering high-quality reagents and materials for these disciplines. Supelco Supelco is the analytical and chromatography products division of Sigma-Aldrich. It supplies analytical standards and reagents, vials, syringes, biocides, and products for sample preparation and purification. Sigma-Aldrich Fine Chemicals (SAFC) SAFC represents the fine chemical supply branch of Sigma-Aldrich, specializing in the provision of extremely high-purity chemicals for advanced applications. Sigma Life Science (formerly Sigma-Genosys) Sigma Life Science offers products such as custom DNA/RNA oligonucleotides, custom DNA and LNA probes, siRNA, isotopically labeled peptides, and peptide libraries for research purposes.
